request.style: English, female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, harp, light percussion, warm and hopeful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Through the Negev they climbed to the land
Where the giants of Hebron stood tall
Ahiman Sheshai and Talmai
The descendants of Anak remained there
A single cluster of grapes
Carried on a pole by two
Forty days they scouted the place
And brought back the fruit of the land

[Pre-Chorus]
It flows with milk and honey indeed
But the cities are strong and the people great
The walls rise up to the sky
And our hearts have melted in fear

[Chorus]
We saw the descendants of Anak
The Nephilim from whom they came
In our own eyes we seemed like grasshoppers
So we seemed to them we said

[Verse]
The whole congregation wept that night
Grumbling against Moses and Aaron
Why bring us here to fall by the sword
Our wives and children become plunder
If only we had died in the wilderness
Or back in Egypt we wished
But one man stood with a different spirit
Caleb who followed wholeheartedly

[Chorus]
We saw the descendants of Anak
The Nephilim from whom they came
In our own eyes we seemed like grasshoppers
So we seemed to them we said

[Bridge]
Joshua cut off the Anakim
From Hebron Debir and Anab
Devoting them to destruction
So none remained in the hill country
Only in Gaza Gath and Ashdod
Did any of them survive

[Outro]
But Caleb drove out the three
Sheshai Ahiman and Talmai
Hebron was called Kiriath-arba
After the greatest among them
